# Terento

> Install and manage third-party maps on Garmin smartwatches with map support using Terento, a free macOS app for Apple Silicon.

Canonical website: https://terento.app/

This supplemental index does not replace the website, robots.txt, or sitemap.

## Key facts

- Terento is a free, open-source (GPL-3.0-or-later) project that installs and manages third-party maps on Garmin smartwatches with map support.
- Two ways to use it: the Terento app for Apple Silicon Macs with macOS 13 or later, or the web installer at https://terento.app/install/ in desktop Chrome, Edge, Opera or Brave, with no app to install.
- The maps are free community maps based on OpenStreetMap data: Freizeitkarte, OpenTopoMap, MapRando, BBBike and OSMapaPL. The Mac app downloads each map directly from its provider and can also install your own compatible .img map file.
- Terento does not update Garmin firmware or official Garmin maps and does not replace Garmin Express.
- The Compatibility page lists exact watch models and variants with at least one successful installation. A model missing from it is not necessarily unsupported.

## Public pages

- [Terento — Third-Party Maps for Garmin on Mac](https://terento.app/): Install and manage third-party maps on Garmin smartwatches with map support using Terento, a free macOS app for Apple Silicon.
- [About Terento — Free, Open-Source Garmin Maps for Mac](https://terento.app/about/): Learn why Terento exists: a free, open-source macOS app for installing and managing third-party maps on Garmin smartwatches.
- [Download Terento for Mac — Third-Party Maps for Garmin](https://terento.app/download/): Download the free, notarized Terento app for Apple Silicon Macs to install and manage third-party maps on Garmin smartwatches with map support.
- [Garmin Watch Compatibility & Successful Installs — Terento](https://terento.app/compatibility/): Terento is designed for Garmin smartwatches with map support. See exact models and variants with successful third-party map installations.
- [Install Third-Party Garmin Maps on Mac — Terento](https://terento.app/guides/install-garmin-maps-mac/): Install third-party maps on a Garmin watch with map support from an Apple Silicon Mac: connect it, choose a map or your own .img file, and install.
- [Garmin Watch Not Showing Up on Mac? Troubleshooting — Terento](https://terento.app/guides/troubleshooting/): Garmin watch not showing up on your Mac? Fix USB mode (MTP), Garmin Express using the watch, low storage and failed map downloads.
- [Install Garmin Maps on Linux from Chrome — Terento](https://terento.app/guides/install-garmin-maps-linux/): Install free OpenStreetMap maps on a Garmin watch from Linux in Chrome, Edge, Opera or Brave: add one udev rule, connect the watch, send the map.
- [Compare Free Garmin Maps: OpenTopoMap vs Freizeitkarte — Terento](https://terento.app/map-styles/): See how OpenTopoMap, Freizeitkarte, MapRando, BBBike and OSMapaPL Garmin maps draw popular hikes, trails and cities before you install one.

## Web installer

- [Install Maps on Your Garmin Watch from Your Browser — Terento](https://terento.app/install/): Install free maps based on OpenStreetMap on your Garmin watch from Chrome, Edge, Opera or Brave: connect it by USB, choose a map, send it. No app needed.
